title: I verbi delle pulizie — Italian Verbs for Cleaning
subtitle: Una lezione tessuta — vocabolario, racconti, e una mattinata con Alice e Marco
source_summary: User-requested vocabulary lesson on Italian cleaning verbs, woven through a narrative spine. Authentic source material from: Natalia Ginzburg (Lessico famigliare, 1963), Italo Calvino (La poubelle agréée, 1977), Umberto Saba (1901), Italian folk humor (barzellette).
level: A2-B1 (intermediate, with stretch B1 stories alongside A2 core)
learning_objectives: Master 14 cleaning verbs + 8 household nouns + 4 cultural collocations.
Conjugate -are, -isco, and regular -ere verbs in the present tense.
Use negative imperatives (non + infinitive) in domestic context.
Read authentic Italian literary excerpts (Ginzburg, Calvino, Saba).
Understand cultural register: pulizie di sabato, pulizie di primavera, regional idioms.
Build automaticity via timed Match Madness (per-pair latency feeds SR scheduler).
authentic_sources_used: Natalia Ginzburg — Lessico famigliare (1963) — Story B1: 'Il padre e l'ordine'
Italo Calvino — La poubelle agréée (1977) — Story B1 immersion: 'Il rito della pattumiera'
Umberto Saba — La casa della mia nutrice (1901) — Story B1 serious: 'La casa'
Barzellette popolari italiane sulle pulizie (public-domain jokes)
